description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointed Mr. P. Danansooriya for the settlement of the Industrial Dispute between Mr. D. S. M. Wijesinghe and Commercial  Credit and Finance PLC and Mr. K. M. Sarathchandra for the settlement of the Industrial Dispute between Mr. N. Dharmakeerthi and Lanka Electricity Company (Pvt.) Ltd.,
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It involves statutory instruments and legal procedures for dispute resolution, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
